patthana15.80:1.1: araṇaṃ sekhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na sekho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. ekaṃ,
patthana15.80:2.1: araṇaṃ asekhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na asekho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. ekaṃ
patthana15.80:3.1: araṇaṃ nevasekhā nāsekhaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na saraṇo na nevasekhānāsekho dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā ekaṃ.
